I have been invited to speak at the **Exemplar Innovation Experience 2026**, held
in Pollenzo on 8–9 October. My talk, *“The strength of the past: analysis and
modelling of historic structures with Abaqus,”* is scheduled for Friday, 9
October, 11:30–11:50.
